formatting.tab_characters: Never use tab characters for indentation — use 4 spaces. Kate editor inserts tabs silently.

qmlformat_rules.description: MagneFire CI lint runs qmlformat on all QML files. Violations cause CI failure.
rules: All JS statements inside handlers and functions require semicolons — QML property bindings do not.
Connections target: property goes at the END of the block after all function handlers.
Root Item member ordering: id, properties, functions, anchors, Component.onCompleted, child items.
Blank line after closing brace of every child Item before next sibling.
Float literals normalised — remove trailing zeros: 1.0 to 1, 0.0 to 0, 0.30 to 0.3.
Imports sorted alphabetically — QtGraphicalEffects before QtQuick.
Single-line if-without-braces expanded to two lines with indented body.
return; becomes return ; with a space.
Behavior blocks always expanded multi-line, never single-line.

formatting.property_naming_minimum_length: All QML property names must be descriptive and grep-safe — single-letter names are banned. Minimum two characters. dialRadius not R, handStroke not lw. Loop variables i/j/k in JS blocks are exempt — local scope, never searched.

watchface_patterns.canvas_to_pathanglearc: Static Canvas arcs (battery, progress, time) must be replaced with declarative Shape+PathAngleArc+sweepAngle bindings. Eliminates requestPaint callbacks and JS execution.
watchface_patterns.pathanglearc_radius_reference: PathAngleArc centerX/centerY/radiusX/radiusY must reference a named Item id (e.g. root.width), never parent.width/height. ShapePath has no geometry — parent inside PathAngleArc resolves to ShapePath not the enclosing Shape.
watchface_patterns.dropshadow_on_animated_layer: Never put layer.effect: DropShadow on an Image or Item that updates at 16ms. Layer+DropShadow forces full 60fps shader recomposite on every frame.
watchface_patterns.canvas_smooth_antialiasing_remove: Remove smooth: true and antialiasing: true from all Canvas items. smooth has no effect on Canvas. antialiasing forces unnecessary compositor work on Shape items.
watchface_patterns.nightstandmode_layer_texturesize: Remove textureSize: Qt.size(width*2, height*2) from all nightstandMode and dockMode layer blocks. Double-resolution offscreen texture upload causes visible stutter on activation.
watchface_patterns.layer_dot_notation: Flatten layer { } sub-object blocks to dot-notation for 1-2 properties: layer.enabled: true / layer.samples: 4. Sub-block syntax only when setting 3+ layer properties including a nested layer.effect.
watchface_patterns.16ms_sweep_timer: Replace Behavior on second hand rotation angle with: Timer { interval: 16; repeat: true; running: !displayAmbient && visible; onTriggered: { var now = new Date(); secondRot.angle = (now.getSeconds() * 1000 + now.getMilliseconds()) * 6 / 1000 } }
watchface_patterns.beluga_full_screen_layout: For watchfaces where content must cover the full screen on Beluga (320x360): use anchors.fill: parent on the root Item and introduce property real sq: Math.min(width, height) as the square reference dimension.
watchface_patterns.chargecolor_missing_colorarray: chargeArc Shape items must declare readonly property var colorArray: ['red', 'yellow', Qt.rgba(.318, 1, .051, .9)]. Omitting this while referencing chargeArc.colorArray in ShapePath.strokeColor causes a silent crash in nightstand mode.
watchface_patterns.burnin_ternary_precedence: Operator precedence bug: width * condition ? a : b evaluates as (width * condition) ? a : b. Always parenthesise: width * (condition ? a : b).
watchface_patterns.visibility_guard_obsolete: The if (!visible) return guard in Connections { target: wallClock } blocks is now obsolete — WallClock.enabled: desktop.visible merged in MainScreen.qml stops the clock ticking behind active apps. Remove from all watchfaces.
watchface_patterns.canvas_to_rectangle: Any Canvas drawing only static filled shapes should be replaced with plain Rectangle items.
watchface_patterns.split_static_animated_canvas: When a Canvas contains both static elements and elements driven by a frequently-changing property, split into two canvases: one static (repaints only on isDark/time change) and one animated overlay.
watchface_patterns.render_strategy_cooperative: All Canvas items in watchfaces should declare renderStrategy: Canvas.Cooperative — yields to the compositor between paints.
watchface_patterns.dropshadow_samples: samples: 9 is sufficient for all soft glows on a 400px display
watchface_patterns.property_types: Use property int or property real for numeric Canvas properties, never property var.
watchface_patterns.pathanglearc_binding: PathAngleArc sweepAngle bindings on wallClock.time.getX() are unreliable — always use stored properties fed from Connections block.
watchface_patterns.hour_arc_overflow: sweepAngle must use (angle % 360 + 360) % 360 to prevent >360 degree fill at PM hours
watchface_patterns.square_root_item: Item { anchors.centerIn: parent; height: Math.min(parent.width, parent.height); width: height }
watchface_patterns.root_item_no_explicit_size: Never set explicit width or height on the watchface root Item — the system fills it to screen size automatically. Setting width: Dims.l(100) breaks all parent.width and parent.height fractions the entire layout depends on.
watchface_patterns.dims_l_360px_base: Watchfaces designed pre-Dims era assumed 360px screen. To convert hardcoded px values to Dims.l: divide by 3.6 to get the percentage.
watchface_patterns.import_qtquick_215_exception: import QtQuick 2.15 is required for PathAngleArc and for PathView flickDeceleration/maximumFlickVelocity to have effect.

qt5_limitations.note: Known limitations and incompatibilities in Qt 5.15 / Qt Quick 2.9 that require workarounds. These are QML/UI-layer limitations — build and platform limitations live in platform_and_build.json.
limitations: Date.now() is unavailable in AsteroidOS QML — returns undefined or behaves unreliably. Workaround: declare a property int (e.g. elapsedTime: 0) and increment it imperatively with elapsedTime += interval inside onTriggered.

QML State PropertyChanges and a Connections block that imperatively sets the same anchor margin on the same target are mutually exclusive at runtime: Connections block wins for all subsequent runtime toggles. Fix: use State/AnchorChanges alone, or ensure the Connections block writes the exact same values the State declares.

ListView with drag-and-drop delegates throws TypeError when the user overscrolls beyond list bounds. Fixes: (1) bind delegate width to the ListView id directly rather than parent.width; (2) set boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds to eliminate the overscroll state entirely.
property Timer foo: Timer { ... } does not register inner Timer id 'foo' in the enclosing Item's id scope. Fix: declare as Timer { id: fadeInTimer } sibling child.

Inside a child Timer's onTriggered, writing to a parent Item property without explicit qualification throws 'Invalid write to global property'. Always qualify: valueMeter.showingBrightness = false, never showingBrightness = false.
PropertyAnimation.onFinished not available in Qt Quick 2.0-2.9 — use Timer-based sequential transitions instead.
NumberAnimation duration not settable as property after declaration — bind to page-level property
property var holding C++-backed QtObject refs unreliable in Connections
Behavior on visible not supported — use Timer + opacity for fade-then-hide
ColorAnimation on Text forces rasterization — prefer Rectangle overlay
Only one Component.onCompleted allowed per QML component
Multi-line ternary where newline precedes colon silently evaluates only first branch — all ternaries must be single-line
Behavior on font.pixelSize not supported — snaps only
SequentialAnimation on a property takes permanent ownership — declarative binding on same property breaks after first run
Per-corner radius not supported on Rectangle — single radius only
clip on Rectangle clips to bounding box not to radius shape
Repeater inside Component not instantiated until createObject — pool pattern preferred
NumberAnimation onStopped does not fire reliably at zero effective duration — wrap in SequentialAnimation with PauseAnimation { duration: 1 } before ScriptAction
QML property lookup only walks to file root — child items cannot resolve unqualified property names from intermediate parent Items
layer.enabled on a child does not prevent opacity inheritance from parent — make child a sibling not a child
Conditional anchors (switching between undefined and real targets at runtime) are unreliable — use two separate items with visibility switching instead.
property var array mutation (unshift, index assignment) does not emit changed signal — always reassign: arr = arr after mutation
Connections deprecated onFoo syntax — use function onFoo() { } syntax in all new code
SequentialAnimation on opacity permanently takes ownership — any opacity: binding on the same Item is silently broken after the first run.
ShapePath.strokeColor alpha channel is silently ignored by Qt Shape renderer — use the parent Item opacity property for visual dimming instead.
JS operator precedence trap: running: !foo > 0 evaluates as (!foo) > 0 not !(foo > 0). Always write running: foo <= 0 or running: foo === 0 explicitly.
Loader always resizes its instantiated root Item to fill the Loader dimensions — wrap the widget in an Item and size the inner widget explicitly.
property alias cannot reference an id that lives inside a Loader-instantiated component — use a plain property on the consumer root and sync via Qt.binding in onStatusChanged.
Column positioner does not support horizontal anchors on children — anchors.left and anchors.right on Column children are silently ignored.
Switch component drives its own opacity from its enabled state internally — setting enabled: false causes permanent opacity reduction that cannot be overridden.
Declarative property binding on a value that emits onChanged fires immediately on ListView delegate re-instantiation when the delegate scrolls back into view — assign only on actual user interaction.
import QtQuick.Controls 2.15 is not available in AsteroidOS Qt 5.15 builds — causes module not found crash. SwipeView and PageIndicator must be replaced with plain QtQuick 2 equivalents.

qt5compat_opacity_mask_no_anchors.pattern: Qt6 Qt5Compat.GraphicalEffects OpacityMask cannot be anchored directly. Wrap in Item { anchors.fill: target; OpacityMask { anchors.fill: parent; ... } }.

import_order_opacity_mask_linear_gradien.pattern: When OpacityMask and LinearGradient from Qt5Compat.GraphicalEffects are used together, QtQuick must precede Qt5Compat.GraphicalEffects in imports regardless of alpha order. qmlformat breaks this file — restore manually after every qmlformat run.

shadereffect_qt6_qsb_required.pattern: ShaderEffect.fragmentShader must point to a pre-compiled .qsb URL. Inline GLSL crashes Qt6. Compile with: /usr/lib/qt6/bin/qsb --glsl '100 es,120,150' --hlsl 50 --msl 12 -o out.frag.qsb in.frag. Place in src/shaders/. Reference as ../shaders/filename.frag.qsb.

chained_text_anchors_forbidden.pattern: Never anchor text items to other text items' top/bottom. Qt6 bounding box expansion cascades through the chain. Always anchor to parent.verticalCenter + verticalCenterOffset.

bold_markup_weight_splitting.pattern: In Qt6, <b> always maps to Font.Bold regardless of base weight. For mixed-weight strings (e.g. bold day number + thin month name), use a Row with two Text items at correct weights. No markup needed.
